# v0.4.7 — Tool calls on newer DSH hosts and a four-page tour

- On DSH 0.2.2-rc.1, enabling TheOne could interrupt file listing, reading, search, and agent listing with an `isOwnedBy` error. These tools now work in ordinary chats and TheOne topics. [Issue #13](https://github.com/YunongDai2005/dsh-theone/issues/13)
- When a topic saves its progress on the first step, main chat now shows the saved result. Previously the topic saved successfully while main chat reported an unknown tool.
- New users see four illustrated pages after their setup choices. The pages show the topic cells, where messages go, how to organise topics by dragging, and how to keep main chat focused on the conversation. If you already finished setup, the tour opens on its own after updating. Choose **Later** for one reminder at the next start, or finish the tour to dismiss it.

## 中文

- 在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 上，启用 TheOne 曾导致列文件、读取、搜索和列出子代理时出现 `isOwnedBy` 错误。普通会话和 TheOne 话题现在都可以正常使用这些工具。
- 话题第一次保存进度时，主聊天会显示实际保存结果。此前进度虽然已写入，主聊天仍可能提示找不到工具。
- 新用户完成设置选项后，会看到四页配图介绍，依次了解话题细胞、消息去向、拖动整理和主聊天提示。此前完成过设置的用户升级后会直接看到介绍。选择「以后再说」会在下次启动时再提醒一次，看完后就不再弹出。
